description: This file defines a Registry class for managing session files, along with related types and functions for handling Playwright client sessions, including loading, saving, and retrieving session data.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Manages session files, allowing loading, retrieval, and updating session entries.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves a session file by client info and session name.

methods.name: entries
methods.description: Retrieves all session files associated with the given client info.

methods.name: entryMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of session files.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a session entry from disk and updates internal state.

methods.name: _loadSessionEntry
methods.description: Private static method to load a session entry from a file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to load all session files from disk into a Registry instance.
